premises.text: Pregnancy complications are rising while prenatal visits are inconvenient, expensive, and limited by outdated technology, leaving moms uncertain
premises.evidence_span: these trips are inconvenient, expensive, and ultimately limited by 50-year-old antiquated technology

premises.text: A medical-grade wearable plus analytics measures maternal/fetal biopotentials (including contractions) to reassure moms and give doctors better information
premises.evidence_span: We combine wearable devices with data analytics to both reassure expecting moms and provide doctors with better information

premises.text: Same sensor roadmap expands via OTA updates to fetal movement and heart rate beyond starting with contractions, outperforming existing/emerging wearables
premises.evidence_span: All of these features will be made available via over-the-air software updates

premises.text: Go-to-market starts DTC monthly subscription with sensor return, then referrals/channels, then FDA reimbursement toward standard of care
premises.evidence_span: We will first offer Bloom Life direct to consumers via monthly subscription

premises.text: Crowdsourced maternal-fetal dataset powers cloud ML to help doctors predict and manage complications before it is too late
premises.evidence_span: crowdsource the largest and most comprehensive data set on maternal and fetal health ever collected

value.text: Improved mom and baby health and birth outcomes, preventing heartache of lost children
value.evidence_span: technology designed to improve the health of moms and babies

secondary_value.text: Peace of mind and clearer communication with doctors for expecting moms
secondary_value.evidence_span: takes the guesswork out of pregnancy and puts need-to-know information about her body and her baby at her fingertips
